card.name: Words just before a named person or provider
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas just before a person, authority or provider is named, such as the comma before 'according to' or 'inform/contact' before 'their healthcare provider'.

modes.label: Comma before attribution
modes.description: A comma after a news claim, before a source or authorities are named.
modes.example: excellent<<,>> according to project manager John Gerpheide

modes.label: Verb before provider
modes.description: Verbs like inform or contact in patient advice, right before healthcare provider or physician.
modes.example: Advise patients receiving CIPRO to<< inform>> their healthcare provider immediately if these reactions occur

modes.label: Word before a title
modes.description: A word that leads into a title or a role noun.
modes.example: issued in 1992 by<< former>> Tanzania President Ali Hassan Mwinyi

card.writes: It suppresses honorific titles like Mr and Dr as the next word, and pushes toward other continuations.
card.plain: It fires on little words right before someone such as a source, provider or official is named.
